title: Seas the Day on 30A | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Seas the Day on 30A is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Seas the Day on 30A – Spacious Beach Retreat with Private Pool & Gulf ViewsWelcome to Seas the Day on 30A, your ideal home-away-from-home in Santa Rosa Beach. This inviting and thoughtfully designed coastal retreat is perfect for large groups, multi-family getaways, reunions, and extended stays. Located just 200 feet from public beach access, you can step out the door and head straight toward sugar-white sand and emerald Gulf waters. The home comfortably accommodates up to 21 guests and comes with a six-seater golf cart for easy exploration of 30A. With flexible sleeping spaces, two full kitchens, multiple living areas, and plenty of room to gather, this property is built for memories that last.Your Home Away from HomeInside, Seas the Day on 30A spans two full floors of living space, each with a full kitchen, full living room, and washer and dryer — ideal for sharing between groups or families. With five bedrooms, four and half bathrooms, and multiple sleeping options, the home comfortably accommodates larger parties:* Bedroom 1: Queen-over-queen bunk bed* Bedroom 2: Queen Murphy bed* Bedroom 3: King bed with private bathroom* Bedroom 4: King bed, with private bathroom* Bedroom 5: Two sets of bunk beds, one queen-over-twin and one twin-over-twin* Other Sleeping: Two queen sleeper sofas, and two blow-up mattress optionsFrom the spacious common rooms to the well-equipped kitchens, this home makes it easy to feed everyone, find your cozy corner, or gather for movie nights and shared meals.Pool & Outdoor LivingStep outside to your private heated pool, available for heating any month with an additional charge, and enjoy sun after surf, poolside BBQs with the gas grill, and alfresco dining. A large deck and plenty of outdoor seating make this space perfect for morning coffee or evening games.Crow’s Nest with Panoramic ViewsAscend to the private Crow’s Nest, the highest point of the home. This special lookout offers sweeping Gulf views and a perfect perch to watch the morning surf, toast with sunset drinks, or simply take in the coastline from above the dunes.Easy Beach Access & 30A LifestyleJust steps from public beach access, you’ll be on soft sand and turquoise water in minutes. When you’re ready to explore beyond the shore, 30A’s world-class biking paths, vibrant dining, local cafes, and unique shops are all within easy reach. Whether you’re chasing sunrises along the coast, sampling local seafood, or cruising Scenic Highway 30A, this location sets the stage for authentic Florida experiences.Nearby AttractionsFor a mix of shopping and dining, visit Gulf Place or stop by Alvins Island for local events. Food lovers will enjoy nearby favorites such as Pizza by The Sea, Pecan Jacks Ice Cream, Shunk Gulley, Vue on 30A, Sunrise Coffee, and Local Catch.For classic beachside meals and casual dining, check out Perfect Pig, Pazzos Italiano, Mimmo's 30A Ristorante Italiano, and Shelby's Beach Bar and Grill, all just a short drive away and offering flavors unique to the 30A region.Adventure & Fun with Xplorie!Your stay at Sea the Day on 30A comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Other Details to Note* Snowbird friendly!* No pets allowed.* Private pool heating is available for an additional fee.* Parking available for up to 10 cars.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
